close_reason: fixed: removed redundant static HashSet; single linear scan through IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS (n=23)
description: find_immutable_patch_key (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/helpers.rs:83-111) uses a static HashSet for the O(1) contains check, but then does a second O(n) linear scan through IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS to obtain the &'static str to return. n=21 so the absolute cost is negligible, but the pattern is inconsistent: either return the canonical string from a HashMap<&str, &'static str> built alongside the existing HashSet (one lookup, one allocation at init), or accept that a 21-element scan is fast enough and remove the HashSet. The current dual-structure is confusing without buying anything.
title: find_immutable_patch_key: O(n) linear scan after O(1) HashSet hit
